title: Reconcile split and rollup groups
brief: Reconcile split and aggregated records at compatible grains.
instructions: Normalize text with lower/trim, replace runs of non-Unicode-letter/digit characters with one space, and collapse whitespace. Do not transliterate Unicode. Account keys use lower/trim with blanks NULL; source keys use trim only with blanks NULL. Keep the smallest partner ID for each non-NULL source key; keep missing keys separate. Map hw, hard ware, and hardware to hardware; supplies remains supplies. Parse strict ISO YYYY-MM-DD, US MM/DD/YYYY, or DD Mon YYYY, in that order; invalid dates become NULL. Preserve all source rows unchanged.

Candidates share a non-NULL normalized account key, even with malformed dates or weak evidence. Description edit distance <=2 earns 30, <=5 earns 15, otherwise 0; missing/empty earns 0. Dates equal/one day/two or three days apart earn 20/15/10, otherwise 0. Equal quantity earns 30, difference one earns 20, otherwise 0. Equal nonempty normalized category earns 10. At least two distinct shared normalized words earns 10. Sum the integer contributions; this is evidence, not probability.

Include singleton groups and one-to-many/many-to-one groups with at most three members per side, never multiple members on both sides. Members share an account block. Multi-member groups require equal aggregate quantity, worth 30 points; other contributions are the minimum constituent pair contributions. Deduplicate identical groups. Canonical keys are r:<numerically sorted comma-separated reference IDs>|p:<numerically sorted comma-separated partner IDs>.
Emit every constituent link of every eligible group, with the complete group score.
starterSql:
SELECT ref_id, account_key, category, event_date, description, quantity, business_unit
FROM reference_events
ORDER BY ref_id
LIMIT 10;
starterExplanation: Inspect immutable reference identities and raw evidence first. This source-only preview intentionally does not yet assemble split and rollup groups.

hints.text: Enumerate compatible small groups before aggregating evidence.
Build sorted ID lists of size one through three; compare aggregate quantities for multi-member groups and take minimum nonquantity pair contributions.
The 4+6 split and rollup are valid groups. A false quantity aggregate with weak evidence must keep its low score.
